task: Find UA or AA flights from London to New York that arrive between 8:00 PM and 11:00 PM on FlightAware.
agent_final_answer:
Filtering FlightAware's Flight Finder for ZLN (London, all airports) -> ZNY (New York, all airports), with Airline = American Airlines + United and Arrival Time = 8pm-11pm, returns exactly two distinct UA/AA flights that arrive between 8:00 PM and 11:00 PM (EDT, New York local time):

1. American Airlines AA141 (AAL141): London Heathrow (LHR) -> New York JFK, arriving 09:05 PM EDT (Boeing 777).
2. United UA921 (UAL921): London Heathrow (LHR) -> New York Newark (EWR), arriving 09:20 PM EDT (Boeing 767).

These were the only matching results ("Showing 6 of 118 flights" = these two flights repeated across Wed/Tue/Mon). No other American or United flights from London to New York arrive within the 8:00 PM - 11:00 PM window.
